wa_dorado_needle_east_ridge.evidence: No source states a total pitch count; all describe short pitches and rope lengths, so 14 can be neither confirmed nor refuted.

wa_dragontail_peak_serpentine_arete.evidence: MP header says "13 pitches"; a SummitPost listing (search snippet only) says 14; one blog counts 16 pitches. No two sources agree on 13.

wa_eldorado_peak_eldorado_glacier_nw.evidence: alpinedave: "three simu-pitches with a 60 meter rope"; SummitPost snippet says eight 60 m pitches (page not readable); MP gives no count. Simul vs belayed styles explain the spread.

wa_forbidden_peak_east_ridge.evidence: MP header: "6 pitches"; guides: "6 to 8 pitches" and "6-8 pitches", so 6 is inside every range.

wa_forbidden_peak_west_ridge.evidence: Mountain School: "8 pitches of 5th class climbing"; Mountaineers (search summary, page 403) says four-pitch; Skyward says 6 pitches of low 5th on the buttress. Three different counts.

wa_johannesburg_mountain_northeast_buttr.evidence: No source gives a total; MP lists none, SummitPost snippet cites roughly 30 roped pitches for one party counting simul. 20 neither confirmed nor refuted.

wa_mount_thomson_west_ridge.evidence: MP lists 6 pitches (search summary); chossclimbers numbers five pitches; jessb describes pitches 1, 2, 2.5, 3, 4 and a final one, about 6. SummitPost gives 4-5 or 7.

wa_north_face_left_buttress.evidence: Only MP covers this line, header "12 pitches", though its last topo entry is P8-P12; no second source found, so a change to 12 is not supported by two sources.

wa_north_ridge_west_side.evidence: A MP user listing (search summary) shows this route as 3 pitches; Mountaineers (not readable) says several short low-5th pitches; AAJ gives two or three for the north ridge. Consistent with 3.
